notes: GAAP. Governmental funds only (no enterprise/proprietary funds; fiduciary/custodial funds skipped). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p6); 'Leases' 67,842,891 under Other Financing Sources recorded as debt_proceeds. Roll-forward: 232,580,573 + 435,674,953 - 475,934,173 + 16,463,915 - 16,463,915 + 67,842,891 = 260,164,244 (ties). ending_cash = Cash and pooled investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet total column (p5); restricted assets 45,022,894 separate. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p3), single Governmental Activities column (balances). governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p4). Detail: General Fund (pp7-8), Road (p9), Health Center (p10) and DC Justice Center (p11) budget-basis schedules; nonmajor funds from the newly trimmed individual-fund budget-basis schedules (pp18-33: Bridge, Community Service, Health Department, State Institutions, Veterans, Register of Deeds Technology, Library, Tourism, Federal Drug Forfeiture, 911 Surcharge, Escrow Liability, 911 Wireless Surcharge, DC Drug Law, Debt Service, Correction Bond, Public Safety Bond), which carry budget figures; only funds with no budget schedule come from their columns of the GAAP combining statement (pp15-17): Corrections Inmate Benefit, PFC CFC 2004 Issue, PFC Goodwill & Parks (Law Enforcement and CAA columns are all zero). Each fund is recorded from one schedule only (no double counting). Budget-schedule lines with no actual amount ('-') are not recorded (e.g. Escrow Liability p28 has no actual amounts; State Institutions transfers in, 911 Wireless and Correction Bond expenditures, Library payments in lieu are '-'). Budget-basis figures differ from GAAP by design. Combining Balance Sheet - Non-Major Governmental Funds (pp12-14) read; not used for balance_sheet (GAAP uses the Statement of Net Position). The p6 Nonmajor column nets the 704,108 Correction Bond -> Public Safety Bond transfer that pp16-17 show gross (no discrepancy). Pages 1-2 are table-of-contents pages; pages 34-38 are statistical schedules with no money data. Read pages 1-38 of 38
